description: Create a new Splits workspace that this agent owns. No browser, no person approves: it is created at once, this agent is its only owner, and its API key has every scope. Use it only when the person explicitly asked for a workspace the agent owns, or when no person can approve. Never choose it because it is faster; when a person is in the conversation and did not ask for it, use `workspace create`. recoveryEmail is required and must be the email the person gave; never make one up. It is the only signer of the root account, which owns the treasury, and whoever logs in to Splits with it becomes an owner of the workspace. Splits sends it no email and does not verify it. This agent's local key is the only signer of the treasury, the deposit address on every chosen chain. A new local key is saved before the call. A key creates one workspace and gets its API key once: a second call with the same key is refused, and a new API key for that workspace needs a browser login (`auth login-start`) that an owner approves. The API key is saved as a new active workspace and never appears in the output. Off-ramp and paid plans stay unavailable until a person joins. The local key is the money: never print, paste or move it. Follow the `next` field of the result, and relay its warning to the person.

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chain ids (e.g. '8453,1'). Defaults to the chains a new workspace gets in the app.

clientName.description: The name of the app the person is using to talk to you (for example `Claude Code`). It names the treasury signer and the API key.

key.description: Saved local key that becomes the treasury signer. Without it, a new key is saved before the call. A key that already created a workspace is refused.

name.description: Workspace name. The local workspace alias is derived from it.

recoveryEmail.description: Email of the person who can recover the workspace, exactly as they gave it. Never make one up. It becomes the root signer, and whoever logs in to Splits with it becomes an owner.

name: workspace_create-agent-owned
